display.purpose: Section headings on inner pages. Always Lora italic.

hero.purpose: Homepage hero only. Two-line split: bold upright + semibold italic gradient.

body.purpose: All prose text. DM Sans regular at comfortable reading size.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, nav cues, attribute pills. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card and container shadow. Barely perceptible.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Brand-colored glow on primary button hover.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Two-layer shadow for glassmorphic Expertise cards.

shadows.name: cta-hover
shadows.purpose: Deep shadow for dark CTA buttons on hover.

shadows.name: hero-badge
shadows.purpose: Delicate blue-tinted shadow for floating hero badge.

motion.name: ease-lumina
motion.purpose: Signature exponential ease-out for all entrance animations.

motion.name: duration-interaction
motion.purpose: Button hover, link color, focus transitions.

motion.name: stagger-delay

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Baby blue pill button for hero CTAs and primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.84 0.09 230); color: oklch(0.18 0.04 240); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border: 1.5px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.78 0.11 230); box-shadow: 0 0 28px oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.42); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.09 230 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Midnight slate pill button for CTA sections and inner-page closing blocks.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.18 0.04 240); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 240); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-dark:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 40px oklch(0.25 0.04 240 / 0.22); } .ds-btn-dark:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.09 230 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Transparent pill with baby blue border for secondary hero actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.04 240); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.42); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.08); border-color: oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.72); } .ds-btn-outlined:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.09 230 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Badge
components.description: Frosted glass pill with pulsing dot, used in hero section only.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 15px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.70); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.28); box-shadow: 0 2px 14px oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.10); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.50 0.025 240); } .ds-badge-dot { display: block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.84 0.09 230); animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite 1s; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.65); opacity: 0.35; } }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Uppercase eyebrow with optional leading accent line, used atop every content section.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-section-label-line { width: 32px; height: 1px; background: oklch(0.84 0.09 230 / 0.50); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-section-label-text { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.7 0.13 230); }

components.name: Contact Input
components.description: Borderless floating-label input with bottom hairline. Contact form only.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 20px 0 8px 0; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.18 0.04 240); background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 240); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: oklch(0.78 0.11 230); } .ds-input-label { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 20px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.18 0.04 240 / 0.30); pointer-events: none; transition: all 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus + .ds-input-label, .ds-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + .ds-input-label { top: 2px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.7 0.13 230); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Horizontal nav with active underline indicator via scale-x transition.
components.html: AccueilLe constatNos résultats
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.18 0.04 240); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.84 0.09 230); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.84 0.09 230); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-active { color: oklch(0.84 0.09 230); } .ds-nav-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview:
Technical precision softened by the calm of open water. The baby blue palette is a deliberate counterpoint to the rigor underneath: this is a studio that builds infrastructure-grade e-commerce sites, but presents that capability through calm, composed surfaces rather than aggressive tech aesthetics. The site should feel like a precisely engineered blueprint rendered in coastal light.

Every surface earns its space. Whitespace is structural, not decorative. Typography carries the hierarchy; color confirms it. Motion exists to guide attention, never to entertain. The result is a site that feels inevitable rather than designed.

This system explicitly rejects: gradient blobs and stock illustrations (generic SaaS energy), scroll-hijacking and parallax excess (Awwwards-bait), template DNA and clip-art icons (cheap freelancer portfolio). If someone could look at this and say "AI made that," it has failed.
keyCharacteristics: Serif/sans pairing (Lora italic for authority, DM Sans for clarity)
Single-hue OKLCH palette: baby blue at hue 230, tinted neutrals
Pill-shaped interactive elements with tactile feedback
Choreographed scroll entrances using a single exponential ease
Dark sections as rhythmic counterpoints, not theme switches
Section eyebrow labels in spaced uppercase as structural markers

rules.name: The Single-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every color in the system lives on hue 230 (or 240 for neutrals). Coastal Teal at hue 178 is the only exception, and it appears only in decorative gradients, never on interactive surfaces.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No color has zero chroma. Even the lightest surface carries 0.005 chroma toward the brand hue.

rules.name: The Italic Authority Rule
rules.body: Display headings are always Lora italic. Upright Lora is reserved for hero line 1 only.

rules.name: The 50ch Rule
rules.body: Centered body text never exceeds 50 characters per line. Left-aligned prose at 65ch.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation change, focus).

dos: Do use the single exponential ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] for all entrance animations.
Do use while-in-view with { once: true } for scroll-triggered entrances.
Do stagger sibling items by 0.07s delay increments.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 230/240. Check chroma is never 0.
Do use symmetric gradient backgrounds for section tinting.
Do use Lora italic for every display heading.
Do cap centered body text at 50ch. Left-aligned prose at 65ch.
Do include the arrow with hover translate on every CTA button.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). The hero gradient second line is the single permitted exception.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface. Expertise cards and hero badge only.
Don't introduce a second saturated hue. No orange, no green, no purple.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. All motion is exponential ease-out.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use identical card grids. Vary layout across sections.
Don't use generic SaaS patterns: gradient blobs, stock illustrations, checkmark comparison tables.
Don't build anything that looks template-derived.
Don't use the words: artisan, pixel, chaleur, magie, passion, digital, bespoke, atelier.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use transform and opacity exclusively.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
